title: Mortgage offer extraction schema
description: Field definitions only. The engine wraps each field as {value, evidence_quote, page} when asking the model, so every value is traceable to the source text.

customer_name.description: Customer name exactly as written in the salutation, including title.

offer_date.description: Date the offer was issued. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

offer_expiry_date.description: Date the offer is valid until. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

property_address.description: Address of the mortgaged property, comma-separated on one line.

mortgage_purpose.description: Why the mortgage is being taken out, e.g. 'purchase (first-time buyer)', 'remortgage'.

property_value.description: Value of the property in pounds, number only (no £ or commas).

loan_amount.description: Total amount of the loan in pounds, including any fee added to the loan.

ltv_percent.description: Loan-to-value percentage as a number, e.g. 85.0.

initial_rate_percent.description: Initial (fixed) interest rate as a percentage number, e.g. 4.89.

initial_period_months.description: Length of the initial rate period in months.

initial_period_end_date.description: Date the initial rate period ends. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

follow_on_rate_percent.description: Rate that applies after the initial period (e.g. the SVR), as a percentage number. Not an illustrative 'rates rise' figure.

monthly_payment_initial.description: Monthly payment during the initial rate period, in pounds.

monthly_payment_follow_on.description: Monthly payment after the initial period at the current follow-on rate, in pounds. Not the illustrative 'if rates rise' figure.

total_amount_repayable.description: Total amount to repay over the term, in pounds.

product_fee.description: Product fee in pounds; 0 if there is none.

product_fee_added_to_loan.description: True if the product fee is added to the loan rather than paid upfront. False if there is no fee.

early_repayment_charges.description: Early repayment charge for each year of the initial period, in order.

overpayment_allowance_percent.description: Percentage of the balance that can be overpaid each year without a charge.

contact_phone.description: Lender's phone number for questions about the offer.
